current_law.statute: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin): VB-G RAM G Act, 2025, Act 36 of 2025
bounded_findings: Statutory 125-day guarantee is per eligible rural household, not each adult.
States may notify peak-season pauses aggregating to 60 days; not evidence of a universal pause.
Normative allocation and Centre-State cost sharing are design features; not proof of denial or delivery.
Field outcomes require work-demand, work-offer, person-day and timely-payment denominators.

original_practice_mcq_audit.scope: Three existing questions from integrated editable master; no newly invented official PYQs.

option_checks.A: False: both laws are household, not adult-individual guarantees; old law 100 days.
option_checks.B: Supported: 2005 100-day historical household framework replaced 1 July 2026 by 125-day household framework.
option_checks.C: False: new Act contains statutory household guarantee.
option_checks.D: False: 125-day statutory guarantee is not per adult individual.

option_checks.A: False: 11.28% is not nominal GDP growth.
option_checks.C: False: national MPI projection is not a Hyderabad-only count.
option_checks.D: Supported: NITI explicitly labels 2022-23 MPI 11.28% PROJECTED, not direct census.

option_checks.A: False: participation percentage is not proportion of day spent.
option_checks.B: Supported: age 6+ all-India female 81.5%, male 27.1% participated in unpaid domestic services.
option_checks.C: False: these are not unemployment rates.
option_checks.D: False: not restricted to urban Telangana working-age persons.
